snippet.title: Fruit Ninja vs Skittles - Universal - HD Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Fruit Ninja vs Skittles by Halfbrick Studios

Worlds will collide in the most colourful Fruit Ninja game ever made!

Fruit Ninja vs. Skittles® is a place where dreams come true and legends are made. Words cannot describe how awesome it is, but we're going to try anyway.

This stellar game features new gameplay and a whole lot more. Some may call it revolutionary. Others may not be ready yet. Call it what you want -- there are good times to be had!
Are you up for the challenge? Can you handle the fun? Then jump on in and prepare for sensory overload. Fruit Ninja vs. Skittles® is here and it's ready to rock your world!

--------------------
KEY FEATURES:
--------------------

CRAZY NEW GAMEPLAY
Giant Skittles®, psychedelic fish, rainbows, more! What DOESN'T this game have? Unleash a flurry of visceral delight with new gameplay mechanics and exciting twists to the Fruit Ninja formula. Hold onto your horses -- you're in for a treat!

BUILD THE RAINBOW. LOVE THE RAINBOW. TASTE THE RAINBOW.
Use masterful swordplay to slice Skittles®, boost your multiplier and fill the screen with euphoria. Delicious targets will appear from all angles and pesky bombs are sure to keep you on your toes. The time to prove yourself is now!

*****
Sound good? Fruit Ninja vs. Skittles® is guaranteed to turn you into the ultimate bringer of sweet, tasty destruction. Worlds will collide, juice will flow and fun will be had. It's a match made in heaven!
